title: "Transducers" by Rich Hickey
summary: Rich Hickey introduces transducers in Clojure, a way to make map, filter and similar algorithms composable independent of the data source. This avoids duplicated implementations and intermediate collections across sequences, channels and streams.
why: HN treats it as the original and definitive explanation of transducers, recommended whenever the concept comes up.

quote.text: If you want a really good intro, watch Rich Hickey's talk about transducers
